desc:
LIMITED EDITION JUMBO RAINBOWS: A frosted toasted cereal featuring limited edition jumbo rainbow marshmallow shapes in addition to Lucky's classic marshmallow hearts, stars, horseshoes, clovers, blue moons, unicorns, rainbows, and tasty red balloons

GLUTEN FREE: A gluten free cereal with 12 vitamins and minerals and a good source of calcium; Enjoy a bowl of this limited edition Lucky Charms Cereal with milk as a magically delicious start to the day

WHOLE GRAIN CEREAL: Kids cereal with 19g of whole grain in every serving (at least 48g recommended daily)

RECIPE INGREDIENT: Make this cereal for kids a part of an easy breakfast or gluten free snacks for kids; A perfect pantry staple that's ready to eat or add to school snack mix recipes or homemade cereal bars; Use some as an ice cream topping

CONTAINS: One cardboard box of crunchy Lucky Charms Cereal with Marshmallows, Limited Edition Jumbo Rainbows, 10.5 oz; Perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals
features:
• A frosted and toasted 11 grams whole grain per serving, oat-based, gluten-free cereal with marshmallow pieces.
  • Convenient and easy to display branded box, 12 - 10.5 oz. boxes per case.
  • Multi-serve format box great for smaller operations. Serve all day as a low-cost meal option.
  • Gluten free breakfast cereal.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Whole Grain Corn, Corn Starch, Corn Syrup, Dextrose. Contains 2% or less of: Salt, Modified Corn Starch, Gelatin, Trisodium Phosphate, Red 40, Yellow 5 & 6, Blue 1, Natural and Artificial Flavor. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
